title: SC01-T1 — the toast (SH01, SH02, SH03)
line: Thirty years. Thirty. Somebody get this woman a medal for putting up with me, right? / Thirty years. Thirty. Somebody get this woman a medal for putting up with me, right? / Thirty years. Thirty. Somebody get this woman a medal for putting up with me, right?
motionPlan: Greg pushes up from his chair at the table's middle, sways a little and taps his wine glass with a fork; the table turns to him smiling → Greg, standing, glass raised, warm grin, delivers the toast to the table → glasses rise around her; Susan almost smiles and lifts her glass an inch
note: Waits for its ingredients' Confirm (the voice masters and the cake card), then one Seedance call (§24K part 5).
